policies.name: visible-gasket-0.0000
policies.interpretation: Null input independently chooses the destination uniformly on the entire actual target line. Chance is intersection length of [projected source − gap*tan4, projected source + gap*tan4] with target segment, divided by segment length. The policy own pool acceptance above is diagnostic only, never used as the chance baseline.
